transcript:
[10:02:11] Microphone: Merci de prendre le temps. Is it all right if I record? 🎤

[10:02:28] System audio: Sí, claro, go ahead. My name is Zoë Nuñez, I run the front desk at the clínica.

[10:02:52] Microphone: Could you tell me about a day when the waiting room got away from you?

[10:03:23] System audio: Last month, a Friday. A señora came in with her niño, he had a fever, and we were already behind by an hour. 😬

[10:04:01] Microphone: What did you tell her?

[10:04:23] System audio: I told her the truth, that I did not know how long. She said “then why am I sitting here” and I had no answer for her.

[10:04:52] Microphone
